description: This Java source file defines a fragment class 'WiFiChatFragment' that manages the UI for a Wi-Fi Direct chat application. It handles the display and sending of chat messages, and includes an inner adapter class for populating message views.

classes.name: WiFiChatFragment
classes.description: A fragment class managing chat UI, message display, and interactions with a ChatManager.

classes.name: WiFiChatFragment.ChatMessageAdapter
classes.description: Inner class extending ArrayAdapter to manage and display chat messages within the ListView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the chat layout, initializes UI components, and sets the send button's click listener.

methods.name: setChatManager
methods.description: Sets the ChatManager object used to send messages.

methods.name: pushMessage
methods.description: Adds a new message to the adapter and updates the display.
